goal: Improve the active Taro gear-slot hierarchy with a smaller slot label, a larger item name, Resolver-owned intrinsic secondary-stat labels, and top-right confirmed enhancement-state markers, while preserving an explicit distinction between item facts and final calculated static attributes.
userValue: Players can scan each equipped item and understand its slot, identity, intrinsic secondary attributes, and confirmed gem/enchant/embellishment state without opening the editor; future attribute calculations remain traceable to the same exact Resolver slot facts.
nonGoals: Do not change target-only outer geometry, the eight route regions, the sixteen-slot grid, or the locked outer-page scroll contract.
Do not change PostgreSQL schema, source ingestion, recommendation semantics, SimC execution, scheduled sync, health/admin judgment, or candidate application semantics.
Do not infer secondary stats, eligibility, configured enhancements, or calculation values from candidates, aggregate totals, craftedStatOptions, modCapabilities, or local drafts.
Do not present final calculated totals as verified when the Resolver reports unavailable static facts for selected enhancements.

currentTruth.factOwner: The canonical Resolver owns per-slot intrinsic item static attributes, final resolved static attributes and confirmed selectedOptions; Taro only binds an exact returned snapshot to the displayed imported rows.

mustChange: The canonical Resolver must expose per-slot itemStaticStats after verified base/variant/overlay resolution and before selected enhancements, alongside the existing final resolvedStats.

The typed domain binding and gear-detail presentation model must expose only identity-bound Resolver itemStaticStats as intrinsic secondary-stat labels and confirmed enhancement state per equipped slot.
GearSlotWorkbench and its styles must render the requested information hierarchy without changing interaction ownership.
The current gear-detail truth and component contracts must record the display boundary.
mustNotChange: PostgreSQL, source ingestion, recommendation, SimC, scheduled sync, health/admin and deployment behavior remain unchanged.
Candidate/variant application and enhancement confirmation remain explicit draft-to-Resolve flows.
The legacy pages/builds/detail.js and unrelated project configuration remain unchanged.
riskUnknown: A long item name and multiple labels may compete with the fixed row height and the top-right state markers.
Initial read-model rows may not carry enough data to assert enhancement eligibility; neutral markers must not claim an applicable slot.
Some verified items may have no intrinsic secondary stats; the UI must distinguish that case from unavailable facts.
evidenceRequired: Targeted Resolver, community import and typed-domain coverage for exact slot identity binding and the itemStaticStats versus resolvedStats boundary.
Targeted model and page-contract Vitest coverage for secondary-stat, unavailable/no-secondary and confirmed-enhancement presentation.
UI architecture audit, typecheck and WeChat build on the final candidate head; CI full profile on that exact head.
Exact candidate-head API smoke and real WeChat acceptance for gear_slot_information_hierarchy, gear_slot_enhancement_state, gear_slot_intrinsic_secondary_stats and gear_static_calculation_boundary.

ownership.factOwner: The canonical Resolver owns the itemStaticStats / resolvedStats split and selectedOptions; the active Taro route, typed domain helper and GearSlotWorkbench only consume an exact identity-bound snapshot.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change extends an existing read-only Resolver snapshot in its fact owner and existing typed/frontend consumers. It adds no request, write path, source ingestion or calculation authority, and uses code rollback plus fail-closed UI fallback.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted Resolver and typed-domain tests prove itemStaticStats is captured before selected enhancements and is never bound on partial, mismatched or unavailable snapshots.
Targeted Vitest proves that slots distinguish intrinsic secondary stats, no intrinsic secondary stats and unavailable facts, while enhancement markers use confirmed selections only.
The UI architecture audit, typecheck, WeChat build, CI full profile and final candidate API smoke verify the exact final runtime head.
The user verifies the exact candidate build in WeChat DevTools for information hierarchy, intrinsic-secondary attribution, enhancement-state markers and no false verified calculation state.

decisionLog.decision: The user confirmed that equipped slot rows should prioritize a smaller slot label, larger item name, real secondary attributes and top-right confirmed enhancement state without changing canonical gear behavior.

The user approved a Resolver-owned split between intrinsic item static attributes and final enhancement-inclusive resolved static attributes. The frontend may consume only an exact itemId plus variantKey bound snapshot; unavailable facts remain explicit and cannot be inferred.
